lines.text: And I'm not gonna sit here Brendan and allow you to lie to me anymore. I don't need you to. I've got enough evidence without you. Brendan.

lines.text: Why? Do you wanna continue this and talk with us and be honest with us so we can get through this, get this off your chest?
